response.sql: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS cross_region_avg FROM regional) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, AVG(r.transaction_count) AS avg_transaction_count, AVG(r.avg_amount - b.cross_region_avg) AS avg_amount_above_cross_region_avg FROM regional AS r CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE r.avg_amount > b.cross_region_avg

assumptions.assumption: The cross-region average gives each region equal weight, regardless of its transaction count.

alternatives.interpretation: The comparison average is the average transaction amount across all transactions, so regions with more transactions have more weight in the baseline.
